task.question: Return the tickers of the 4 instruments with the highest annualised volatility over their entire history, in descending order. Use daily simple returns, ddof=1, times sqrt(252).

result.question: Return the tickers of the 4 instruments with the highest annualised volatility over their entire history, in descending order. Use daily simple returns, ddof=1, times sqrt(252).
result.cited_sql:
WITH ordered_prices AS (
  SELECT 
    i.instrument_id,
    i.ticker,
    p.date,
    p.close,
    LAG(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY i.instrument_id ORDER BY p.date) as prev_close
  FROM prices p
  JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.instrument_id
),
daily_returns_with_mean AS (
  SELECT 
    instrument_id,
    ticker,
    date,
    (close / prev_close - 1) as daily_return,
    AVG(close / prev_close - 1) OVER (PARTITION BY instrument_id) as mean_return
  FROM ordered_prices
  WHERE prev_close IS NOT NULL
),
variance_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    instrument_id,
    ticker,
    SUM((daily_return - mean_return) * (daily_return - mean_return)) / (COUNT(*) - 1) as variance,
    COUNT(*) as n_returns
  FROM daily_returns_with_mean
  GROUP BY instrument_id, ticker
)
SELECT 
  ticker,
  SQRT(variance * 252) as ann_volatility
FROM variance_calc
ORDER BY ann_volatility DESC
LIMIT 4
